name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::cTextureAtlas (constructor, all zeros; hooked as a placement-new adapter)
notes: Lane OL (rendering R4b step 1): the texture atlas packer, hooked at its own RVA (shared with the scenegraph's render-target textures and other callers). Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Constructor: the original and ours on a pattern-filled 0x20-byte object, compared field by field (counters and both vectors empty).

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::AllocateIn
notes: Lane OL: the packer's search. Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences: random Init / Allocate / AllocateIn / AddNode / Free / Clear sequences in lockstep on the original and ours; after every step the return value and the whole object are compared (counters, node vector size, capacity and fields with the three padding bytes after used not compared: the original leaves them as the allocation had them, ours zero; free list size, capacity, elements). AllocateIn is never called on a node on the free list (the original would hand the node out as its own child).

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::AddNode
notes: Lane OL: a recycled or new node. Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences (direct random calls with random rectangles and parents, and through every split).

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::Allocate
notes: Lane OL: a region of a size, or -1. Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences.

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::Free
notes: Lane OL: a region handed back, free siblings merged up the tree. Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences (random order of frees).

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::Init
notes: Lane OL: free area and the root node. Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences (after the constructor and after Clear).

name: nGZGraphic4::cTextureAtlas::Clear
notes: Lane OL: counters zeroed and both vectors cleared (storage kept: the capacities are compared). Difftest GZTextureAtlas_Sequences.
